target_customer: Consumers wanting video advice from experts and leaders
problem: Hard to get personal advice from top experts; Mentorcam offered asynchronous video answers.
business_model: Marketplace take rate on video answers

exit.reason: Not public; mentor.cam now redirects to a GoDaddy for-sale page

competitors.name: Intro
competitors.traction_then: About 75 experts and 500 sessions in first two months

technical_complexity.rationale: Mobile video messaging app and marketplace.

defensibility.rationale: Value depended on recruiting famous experts; no lock in or data moat.

market_need_then: Creator economy and Cameo-style video demand grew in 2021; Mentorcam's own demand evidence not found.

branding.domain_note: mentor.cam (.cam TLD); now parked for sale on GoDaddy

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive pun on .cam domain; no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Mentorcam raised a $1.4M round led by General Catalyst in March 2021 and joined YC that summer, but the domain is now for sale and the company is inactive. Totals reported by databases conflict and no post mortem exists. The cause is not public; the failure factors are inferred from the need to recruit famous experts and the lack of a visible later round.
notes: March 2021 round called pre-seed by the Business Wire release title and seed by SoCalTech; recorded pre_seed per the press release. The $130K Sept 2021 item rests on CB Insights alone (likely the YC deal). The $4.1M Snö Ventures Sept 2021 item rests on a single outlet (Nordic9) and a follow-up search could not confirm it; it may be a mix-up with Mentor Spaces. Business Wire returned 403 on fetch so its text was not read. Failure factors are inferred.
